name: valin
description: Valin, a mounted paladin hero: a young man with tousled brown hair in white-and-gold plate armour with big gold-trimmed pauldrons, a white tabard bearing a gold sun and a blue cape, a golden spiked morning star on a short brown haft in his RIGHT hand (screen-left) and a round white shield with a gold sun and gold rim on his LEFT arm (screen-right), riding a white horse with a gold bridle, a white caparison with a gold sun emblem and gold trim, a cream mane and tail and dark hooves
hands: the morning star stays in Valin's right hand on the screen-left side and the round sun shield on his left arm on the screen-right side
